15   例高アンモニア血症を認め, 長期間の浮動性の意識障害を主訴とした. 2 例は維持透析患者であった．画
16   像診断は腹部造影 CT とバルーン閉塞下経静脈造影によった．全例で内科的治療には効果は乏しく，3 例
17   で短絡路の閉鎖によって症状の改善が認められた．アンモニア値測定がスクリーニングには最も重要で
18   あるが，Fischer 比や ICG 値の変化が臨床症状に相関した．浮動性の意識障害において神経内科医師は肝
19   硬変症がない門脈大循環短絡症の可能性を念頭に診療し，短絡路の閉鎖が有効な治療法である事を銘記
20   しておかなければならない．

review.content_class_rationale: Japanese-language manuscript PDF (the source describes it as "PDF-Japanese"): a translation of the article text with line numbers, no tables or images. Not a checklist, literature table, lab file or dataset.

estimated_counts.basis: pdfinfo page count read by the machine peek and confirmed by rendering every page

review.notes: All eight rendered pages were viewed. This is the authors' Japanese version of the English article (cases 1 to 4, results, discussion, figure legends). No numeric value differs. Three wording differences are recorded as annotation ambiguities: case 1 conservative drugs named without "such as" and without routes, ammonia described only as decreased after dialysis (English text says normalized), and the Figure 1 legend placing the variation on the same hospital day (English caption says one day before and after). Not treated as an additional patient record.
limitations: Treated as background because it carries no table, figure or numeric series of its own beyond the English article; patient-level ownership evidence is therefore not assigned, and the three wording differences live in the annotation ambiguities.
Reviewed by the Claude Sonnet 5.5 annotator from rendered pages of the cached PDF.
